description: CDC National Wastewater Surveillance System (NWSS) sampling sites in one US state (data.cdc.gov): wastewater plant, county, population served, 15-day detection proportion, percentile and sample dates. The pathogen is not named in the dataset; this is not confirmed COVID-19 activity. Up to 50 sites per call. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

state.description: US state name as in the dataset, e.g. Vermont, 3 to 40 letters and spaces
